name: Frost Moon
desc: Long before the children of humanity were born from the cradle of the sky, three silver lights had already risen above the earth. The ancient spirits of the frostbound reaches called them "Dilimbabbar." By them, the waxing and waning of light were first distinguished, spring and autumn were set into order, and the passage of years slowly came to be. Yet now, as time flows ever onward, only one of those three silver lights remains.

imgDesc.text: Upon the Lunar Highlands, ruins from time immemorial stand in solemn silence.
High atop the Moongazers' tower, a pioneer turned his gaze to the starry sky, deep and unwavering.
A single flower holds a world within.
Endless energy is drawn from the moon's core, fueling the ancient dragon's ascent to the heavens.
When you gaze upon the moon, the moon gazes back at you.
The heavens shattered like foam, and from their ruin spread a vast sea of Archaeolune Energy.
From amid the starry firmament returns the Dragon Lord of Darkness, come to shatter the throne of the winged usurper.
The moon maiden lifted a corner of the veil that led to the moon's core, and through it flowed the great power of creation to the scholars who yearned for it.
The moon's heart pulses without end, and from it flow milk-springs of nurture, gathering into a sea for the newly born.
Into this lake flow milk-springs of many colors, forming a cradle for the newly born.
Vast auroras ascend to the firmament, as storms of the moon rend the starry heavens.

"O world-shaking lord! It forges the bones of the earth.
It bids all dreams return to the earth, and all dreamless things to return to the earth."
Amid vast blossoms hanging upside down, a body lies asleep — one that brought the ancient dragons a warning from the cosmos.
The shattered space station and spaceship wreckage tell of the tragedy that once befell this place.
"Only the silent stones record all things."
"May that night arrive beneath clear skies... with friends reunited."
A Moonshade Tree, shaped through selective gene tuning, spreads its branches wide. The blackbody matter it emits can form a vast screen, shielding this place from prying eyes and hostile observation.

customize.name: Teardrop of the Moon
customize.desc: A clear, radiant azure crystal that holds an exceptionally pure form of kuuvahki. It possesses a near-perfect affinity with all types of elemental energy.

customize.name: Luna Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.
This sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

customize.name: Kuuhenki Shrine Key
customize.desc:
A key that can break the seal on the ancient Kuuhenki Shrines scattered around the Frost Moon.
These shrines that were built upon the moon's surface lost the benevolent being in whom faith was vested in ancient days as the will of the moon faded away. These secret keys found upon the frigid lunar soil can be used to break the seals — or perhaps they only use the fading voices of the past to help the shrines forget all that has come to ruin.

customize.name: "Mushteshir"
customize.desc: The first "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" ever to remain upon the lunar surface. It is said to be a prototype built by the dragon researcher Maagees-Geti. It was originally created as a cooperative mechanism to aid in lunar research. But as time passed, it was entrusted with power and responsibilities far beyond the purpose for which it had first been designed. The one who made it has long since forgotten the name "Mushteshir." Yet the machine still remembers the duty bound to that name: to be a guide, a pioneer, and an eternal sentinel watching over the stars that have yet to be reached.

customize.name: Prism Slime
customize.desc: Legend says that the first element was once dispersed like light through a prism, until the Creator high above separated it into seven forms. Only then did life upon the earth gain fixed substance and shape. Only here, in this corner of the moon, can elemental forms taken from the mortal world be steeped in flawless source-light, allowing them to retrace their origins and return to the primordial state in which all things were one. Perhaps the primordial light said to reverse destruction works by the same principle.

customize.name: Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
customize.desc:
An ancient machine trapped amongst the lunar ruins. Even the sturdiest and most reliable machines will be conquered by the passing of long years, losing the purpose bestowed upon them by their creators. Now, this entity only attacks and eliminates anything that dares set foot on the ground it defends.
In the records of a long-lost ancient civilization, these out-of-control machines were once called "Ur-Namrasit-Tilimtu-Babbar," or "the one who brings light to the darkness." With a yearning for the boundless sea of stars, the leaders of the "pioneers" engraved their most earnest words in golden sigils, hoping that their successors, with the help of these assistants, would be able to keep the light that illuminates the universe shining bright.
Alas, the light did not arise for anyone, and the machine that was given the title of "overseer" did not manage to wait for the one it should have served. Now, stranded in these ruins, it is but the last, out-of-control remnant of a long-lost ideal.

customize.name: Icy Crystal: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Cryo, resulting in its present form.
It is said that this entity is closest to the original form of a Frostnight Scion. It will use icy mists and crystals to set up redoubtable walls, but perhaps it does this only to separate the flawless primeval light from the world that lies beneath the moon.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Gilded Sunshard: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Geo, resulting in its present form.
Just about its entire body is covered by the accumulated Geo, while its tough antlers gleam with the luster of polished amber.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Tangled Vines: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Dendro, resulting in its present form.
This entity has a marvelous resonance with the plant life of the groves. Some say that one of the Moonchanters once made a contract with the wooded lands with their help, thus becoming a friend and companion to all life on this land.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Surging Currents: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form.
Its clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Gleaming Charge: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Electro, resulting in its present form.
One of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, it commands steel-shattering bolts of lightning like mere servants, such that any land it passes through shall be marked as if by a marauding, thunderous calamity.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker
customize.desc:
An ancient ruin automaton used in object collection.
Legend has it that these ancient ruin machines were designed for specialized work functions, primarily conducting experimental work such as capturing and collecting samples, and had only basic combat functionality.
According to rumor, these were not built by humans, but are instead creations of a yet more ancient civilization. Today, that civilization has been lost, and all that remains are these strange machines that roam the land.

customize.name: Capybara
customize.desc:
These herbivores, which often dwell close to the water, are famous for their steely, stoic "won't even twitch if lightning strikes right next to their toes" disposition. Tourists consider them to be the paragon of animal friends.
Capybaras like to zone out while having a soak in the water, or sun themselves on the shore, and it's quite common for them to barely move for most of the day, as though not a single thing in the world could possibly perturb their calm demeanor and make them anxious. Despite their fluffy appearance, their hairs are actually quite hard and tough. If you pet them in the same direction as their coat of hair, it feels relatively smooth, but should you pet them in the opposite direction, you may end up with a scratched hand. Perhaps that is the reason even famished predators do not regard these completely harmless and quite defenseless little friends as prey...
